releases.notes:
Relicensed under the **GNU General Public License v3.0**. Same three Minecraft targets as 1.2.0, same module behaviour — only the license and author metadata changed.

| Minecraft | JAR | Java | Meteor build |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21.5 | `pearl-puller-addon-1.2.1+mc1.21.5.jar` | 21 | 54 |
| 1.21.11 | `pearl-puller-addon-1.2.1+mc1.21.11.jar` | 21 | **86** |
| 26.2 | `pearl-puller-addon-1.2.1+mc26.2.jar` | **25** | 20 |

Each JAR declares only its own range — `>=1.21.5 <1.21.11`, `>=1.21.11 <26.0.0`, `>=26.2` — so Fabric Loader refuses the wrong one at startup. Together they cover 1.21.5 and everything above it. All three are compiled and tested.

The 1.21.11 JAR accepts any Meteor Client version (`meteor-client: *`). It is compiled and tested against Meteor **1.21.11-86**.

### Changes from 1.2.0

- `LICENSE` is the verbatim GPL-3.0 text, replacing MIT.
- `fabric.mod.json` declares `GPL-3.0-only` and credits `Sarutan`.
- Each source file carries a short license notice header.

The 1.2.0 JARs still embed the old MIT declaration, which is why this release exists.

### Install

Put the matching JAR in the instance's `mods` folder alongside Fabric API and Meteor Client for that same Minecraft version, then enable **Emergency Pearl Pull** in Meteor and set the bot username. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all three JARs.

releases.notes:
> **Superseded by [1.2.1](https://github.com/Sarutan/pearl-puller-meteor-addon/releases/tag/v1.2.1).** The JARs below embed the old `MIT` license declaration and the author `cgsch`. The project is now GPL-3.0; 1.2.1 is the same three builds with corrected metadata.

One JAR per Minecraft version. Download the one that matches your game.

| Minecraft | JAR | Java | Meteor build |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21.5 | `pearl-puller-addon-1.2.0+mc1.21.5.jar` | 21 | 54 |
| 1.21.11 | `pearl-puller-addon-1.2.0+mc1.21.11.jar` | 21 | 84 |
| 26.2 | `pearl-puller-addon-1.2.0+mc26.2.jar` | **25** | 20 |

Each JAR declares only its own range — `>=1.21.5 <1.21.11`, `>=1.21.11 <26.0.0`, `>=26.2` — so Fabric Loader refuses the wrong one at startup instead of letting it fail later. Together they cover 1.21.5 and everything above it. All three are compiled and tested; a version inside a declared range but not in the table is untested.

### Why three JARs instead of one

1.0.0 pinned exactly 1.21.11. 1.1.0 widened that to `>=1.21.5` from a single JAR, which does not hold across the range:

- **Yarn mappings stop at 1.21.11.** There are no Yarn builds for any 26.x version.
- **Minecraft 26.x ships unobfuscated**, so the 26.2 build uses the official names directly. Those names differ from Yarn's (`isOf` against `is`, `getOffHandStack` against `getOffhandItem`), so the same source cannot compile against both.
- **Minecraft 26.x requires Java 25**, where the 1.21.x builds target Java 21.

Module behaviour is unchanged from 1.0.0. The trigger logic is single-sourced in `PullTrigger` and is what the tests cover.

### Install

Put the matching JAR in the instance's `mods` folder alongside Fabric API and Meteor Client for that same Minecraft version, then enable **Emergency Pearl Pull** in Meteor and set the bot username. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all three JARs.

releases.notes:
> **Superseded by [1.2.0](https://github.com/Sarutan/pearl-puller-meteor-addon/releases/tag/v1.2.0). The version range below is too broad — use 1.2.0 instead.**
>
> This JAR declares `minecraft >=1.21.5` but is compiled only against 1.21.11 with Yarn mappings and Java 21. On Minecraft 26.x that declaration is wrong in both directions: 26.x ships unobfuscated with different names and requires Java 25, so Loader accepts this JAR and it then fails at runtime. 1.2.0 ships one JAR per version with correct, non-overlapping ranges.

### Supported versions

- **Minecraft 1.21.5 and every version above it**
- Fabric Loader 0.16.0 or newer
- Any Meteor Client build
- Java 21

### Tested versions

Only **Minecraft 1.21.11 with Meteor Client build 84** is compiled and tested — that is the combination this JAR is built against.

### Changes from 1.0.0

`fabric.mod.json` no longer hard-pins `minecraft` to exactly `1.21.11` and `meteor-client` to `1.21.11-84`. Module behaviour is unchanged.

releases.notes:
First public release for Minecraft 1.21.11 and Meteor Client build 84. The source, build workflow, installable JAR, and SHA-256 checksum are included.

### Supported versions

**Minecraft 1.21.11 only.** This JAR hard-pins `minecraft 1.21.11` and `meteor-client 1.21.11-84`, so Fabric Loader refuses it on any other version.

For Minecraft 1.21.5 and later, use [1.1.0](https://github.com/Sarutan/pearl-puller-meteor-addon/releases/tag/v1.1.0) instead.
